analysis: Retrospective all-endpoint robustness audit; no new model or protected input

original_run.method: All anonymous completed job-log panels; archive ZIP digest reported by GitHub, not independently downloaded.

rule.total: All four variants exploratory_estimable and both geographic-block and first-source-group pointwise 95% intervals strictly same sign.
rule.phi: Same conditions plus >=200 paired islands, >=30 groups, >=1800 valid draws, nondegenerate, separately for both groupings. Phi calculated on its own defined-variance cohort, not necessarily the total covariance cohort.
rule.within_between: Same four variants and pointwise interval direction; no separate variable-stratum or genus-influence support check in this audit.
rule.interpretation: All thresholds and screens are retrospective robustness filters, not familywise tests or independent replication. Original_native means literal recorded-native, not verified native status for all records. No effective pollinator or evolutionary inference.
